newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit falls against dollar on peso effect.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit falls against dollar on peso effect.

text.p: The ringgit was pressured throughout Asian trading on Friday by spillover effects from the Philippines financial situation, dealers said.
The Philippines Central Bank said on Friday it would allow the peso to trade in a wider range against the U.S. dollar, with immediate effect.
Dealers saw the move as the second de facto devaluation of an Asian currency in less than two weeks.
"People are already talking that speculators will be targetting the ringgit next," said a Malaysian bank dealer. "There was a lot of profit-taking today."
